description: This file is a shell script named 'release.sh' that automates the release version bump process. It analyzes Git commit history, applies labeling heuristics or GitHub PR labels, determines version bumps, and optionally updates metadata YAML files accordingly.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the PR number associated with a given commit SHA.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels for a specific PR via GitHub API.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component directory from a file path.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Determines if a path resembles documentation or metadata files.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on current values and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates version and generation in a component's metadata.yaml file.
